title: Aureline M5 resolve-or-close sheet
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a resolve-or-close sheet. Names the object class, its change-intent association, the resolution outcome, the final-resolution authority, and the blocker state — so tracked work is never auto-resolved while engineering blockers remain unresolved. Downstream the resolve-or-close sheet, work-item detail, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a resolution by hand. Secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
